tools.name: search_policies
tools.description: Search Verbaterm's judged, citation-checked public policy corpus (companies, products, policy kinds). Returns derived review metadata — findings counts, scores, freshness — never raw policy text.

tools.name: list_policies
tools.description: List published public-library policy reviews available in the corpus.

tools.name: get_policy_review
tools.description: Get the full judged review for one published policy: findings with verbatim citation excerpts, scores, summary, and provenance. Cite the source URLs back to the user.

tools.name: start_private_review
tools.description: Start a private Verbaterm review of pasted policy text (requires a Verbaterm API key; debits the caller's plan allowance, not API credits). Returns a sessionId to poll with get_private_review_progress.

tools.name: get_private_review_progress
tools.description: Poll progress of a private review started with start_private_review.

tools.name: get_private_review_result
tools.description: Get the completed private review (findings + citations) for a session started with start_private_review. Raw source text is not returned.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Ask a citation-grounded follow-up question about a public library review or a private session (requires a Verbaterm API key; debits the caller's plan Q&A allowance).
